subject: CloudSprint accelerator — eligibility & partner-sourced credit request
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@cloudsprint.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: CloudSprint accelerator — request for partner-sourced credits

Hi Naomi / Aisha,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off the Spring cohort for the CloudSprint accelerator (cohort ID: CS-2028-03) and have a handful of portfolio startups that want to pilot on Redwood. The accelerator covers subsidized credits for accepted teams; we typically route those through partner-sourced credits rather than vendor coupons.

Quick ask: can Redwood allocate partner-funded trial credits for up to 8 companies (roughly 10k tokens each) and allow a 90-day pilot window instead of the standard 60? Attached is our coop request form and an initial list of companies.

We’ll need the following to finalize:
- Confirmation of total credit pool you can commit to (USD token equivalent)
- Any guardrails on usage (per-account caps, billing triggers)
- SSO/SCIM support note for enterprise teams (some request early SSO)

If helpful I can jump on a quick 20-min call with Marcus to align on ops.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Partnerships Lead, CloudSprint Accelerator
ops@cloudsprint.co

Attachment: CloudSprint-Coop-Req.pdf (PDF, 132KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@cloudsprint.co>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSprint accelerator — request for partner-sourced credits

Hi Elena — thanks for the packet and the cohort details. This is something we can support but need to confirm a few internal items before committing to 90 days.

Short answers up-front:
- We can provision a partner credit pool, but final approval depends on partner budget cadence and legal MSA signoff.
- Default per-account cap we typically set is the equivalent of 10k tokens; we can increase on a case-by-case review.
- SSO/SCIM: supported on Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted pilots we can enable SSO where the cohort teams are enterprise customers — will need a technical contact and timeline.

Marcus / Priyom — can you run ops/finance on this and confirm what we can commit for Spring? Marcus, please draft the allocation matrix and include per-account caps and if we can stretch to a 90-day window. Priyom, loop in legal if we need an MSA amendment or addendum for pooled credits. Elena — I’ve added the HubSpot deal link to track.

Next steps:
1) Marcus to propose allocation and constraints (by EOD Mar 3)
2) Legal to confirm whether addendum is required (Priyom)
3) If approved, Naomi will send DocuSign for the partner credit agreement and provisioning timeline.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
(Attachment: credits-allocation-sheet.xlsx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@cloudsprint.co>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSprint accelerator — request for partner-sourced credits

Thanks Naomi — quick ops note (see matrix attached):
- Proposed pool: $80,000 equivalent (token-model conversion attached) to cover ~8 teams at ~10k token-equivalent each.
- Default time window: 60 days. An extension to 90 days is doable for this cohort but requires a minor billing cadence exception and an additional usage reporting checkpoint at day 60.
- Per-account guardrails: soft cap at allocated amount, hard throttle at 125% to prevent runaway spend. Alerts to partner ops when >80% consumed.

SSO: For hosted pilots, we can run SAML onboarding for cohort teams if the team provides an IdP contact. For companies needing SCIM provisioning we recommend Dedicated for the pilot.

Action items I’ll own:
- Finalize allocation-matrix.csv and send to Elena (attached).
- Flag any accounts that look like enterprise (for SSO priority).
- Draft opt-in terms for a 90-day extension and the 60-day checkpoint.

Marcus Lin
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: allocation-matrix.csv)

From: Elena Torres <elena@cloudsprint.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSprint accelerator — request for partner-sourced credits

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two clarifications from our side:
1) We accept the $80k pool. Please note two of the startup teams are pre-Series A but will need SSO for pilot treatment — I’ll share the IdP contacts once we finalize onboarding.
2) We do want the 90-day window. The day-60 reporting checkpoint is fine; we’ll schedule a check-in with Marcus.

One ask: can Redwood set per-account expiration relative to each team’s activation date rather than a cohort-wide end date? That lets teams activate when they’re ready. If not feasible, we’ll accept cohort-wide dates.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421-HP-5421

Thanks,
Elena

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@cloudsprint.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSprint accelerator — request for partner-sourced credits

Elena — great, thanks for confirming. We can proceed on the plan Marcus outlined. Two operational notes before I send the DocuSign:

1) Activation window: We will provision per-account credits that expire relative to each account’s provisioning date (i.e., each team gets a 90-day window from when we enable their account). That is the cleanest way to avoid wasted credits.

2) DocuSign and provisioning timeline: I’ll send a short partner credit addendum via DocuSign today (link will come from docusign@redwood.ai). Once signed, ops will provision the credit pool and Marcus will email each company a provisioning checklist (IdP contact if SSO required, team admin email). Provisioning ETA: 3 business days after signature.

3) Reporting: We’ll set automated usage alerts at 80% consumption and run the day-60 usage checkpoint report back to CloudSprint.

Next steps:
- Naomi: send DocuSign addendum (today)
- Elena: confirm IdP contacts for teams needing SSO (by Mar 9)
- Marcus: provision pool after sign and start onboarding checklist messages

Elena — thanks for partnering on this. Looking forward to the Spring cohort.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
(Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421-HP-5421 ; DocuSign envelope pending)
